title: Distillation big win on LoCoMo may not transfer to featurebench engineering memory
summary: New LoCoMo (50-probe) result: distill (atomic facts) 34 percent and combined (distill + raw search) 36 percent massively beat raw-notes our-way (DAG/EdgeJudge) at 10 percent; search 12 percent; cold 0 percent (clean floor). So distillation is the dominant lever ON LOCOMO, and the CANDIDATE production retrieval is the full DAG pipeline + distilled combine. CAVEAT (do not skip): (1) distillation is currently BENCH-ONLY — bench/agent-memory/distill.py is an ingest-time transform that LLM-extracts atomic facts from a session and writes them via the existing post_note path; it is NOT in the daemon. (2) The LoCoMo win may NOT transfer to featurebench: on featurebench the raw-notes DAG 'on' arm already scores 76.7 percent (LLM-judge rescore) vs LoCoMo's 10 percent — because featurebench notes are already atomic-ish engineering facts, while LoCoMo sessions are long noisy conversations where atomic extraction helps most. DIRECTIVE: the combined ON-vs-OFF bench must MEASURE the distill delta on featurebench (ON arm runs BOTH raw-DAG and DAG+distill) BEFORE distillation is promoted into the production daemon. Seeding distilled notes for the ON arm is a bench-side step (call distill.py then the production gate-first retrieval) — no daemon change is needed to TEST it.
